method: Complete candidate survey followed by individual editorial choices and written reasons, applied to the existing complete guide to keep it within 300 quotations. All verified authorized selections included. Priority given to foundational teachings, substantive explanations, necessary qualifications, distinctive applications, narrative examples and thematic breadth across shared need and reciprocal prayer, remembrance across distance, presence and service on another’s behalf at the Shrines, children, parents and households, care within difficult circumstances, learning, work and gifts put to use, grief, forgiveness and continuing love, protection and refuge, gatherings becoming communities, the language of branches and kinship, women remembered and strengthened, humility and mercy beyond deserving, words to carry into one’s own prayer, love becoming character and service, the Báb’s prayers and sacred remembrance, and the widening circle toward strangers and enemies. Neither citation count nor source order used as a ranking rule. The existing reading arc is retained.

selected.text: We ought to pray for Miss X, that she may become just as God wishes her to be.
selected.reason: Reported words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that we ought to pray for another that she may become just as God wishes her to be; frames intercession as hope for growth rather than judgment.

selected.text: I supplicate at the Threshold of Oneness for forgiveness of sins for your parents
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that He supplicates for the forgiveness of the correspondent’s parents; concise prayer for parents.

selected.text: We beseech God that He may cause him to return unto thee in humility and repentance.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh beseeching God that a person return to the correspondent in humility and repentance; prayer for reconciliation.

selected.text: and a prayer has been written for Jinab-i-Mirza and is being sent within this letter.
selected.reason: Note of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a prayer has been written for a named friend and enclosed in the letter; shows a prayer sent across distance as a written gift.

selected.text: In all conditions he remembered his relatives and performed pilgrimage on their behalf
selected.reason: Account by ‘Abdu’l-Bahá of a believer who in all conditions remembered his relatives and performed pilgrimage on their behalf; a narrative example of acting for others.

selected.text: he has devoted himself to servitude at the Divine Threshold, and day and night offers prayers on your behalf and seeks forgiveness from the Lord of Creation
selected.reason: Account by ‘Abdu’l-Bahá of one devoted to servitude at the Divine Threshold who day and night prays for the correspondents and seeks forgiveness for them; intercession by another on their behalf.

selected.text: Bestow Thou a refuge and protection to this homeless and shelterless servant of Thine, Rostam Iran
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking refuge and protection for a homeless and shelterless servant; brief but direct prayer for the vulnerable.

selected.text: O Thou Kind Almighty, confirm Thou this servant of Thine, Mr. Fraser, in the service of Thy Kingdom.
selected.reason: Words inscribed by ‘Abdu’l-Bahá in a church book asking God to confirm a named man in the service of the Kingdom; prayer written in another community’s book.

selected.text: O Lord! Grant that this dearly-loved maidservant of Thine may proclaim the servitude of Abduil-Baha
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a dearly loved maidservant may proclaim His servitude; a woman’s speech dedicated to servitude.

selected.text: I offered prayers to the Divine Kingdom and sought forgiveness of sins for Mrs. Hannen's mother and Miss Noblack
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that He sought forgiveness of sins for Mrs. Hannen’s mother and another woman; prayer for others’ relatives in the closing circle.

selected.text: will return and become the cause of your gladness, joy, happiness and delight. I have not forgotten and will never forget thee, and I ever seek divine grace, assistance
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá, “I have not forgotten and will never forget thee”, as He seeks grace and assistance; constancy of remembrance.

selected.text: We have remembered those who are there in a measure that none can reckon save God, the All-Numbering, the All-Knowing.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh that those far away have been remembered in a measure none can reckon save God; the abundance of divine remembrance.

selected.reason: Promise of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to supplicate divine assistance on others’ behalf in His moments of leisure at midnight; a concrete picture of intercession kept in a crowded life.

selected.text: Thy mention was made at the Divine Throne, and thus hast thou been blessed with the remembrance of the Beloved of the worlds.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh that the correspondent’s mention was made at the Divine Throne and he is thus blessed with remembrance; being named before God as a blessing.

selected.text: Prayer for forgiveness for Professor Cheyne and Mr. Daniel Jenkinsâ … Grant these two free birds flight to the highest heaven
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for forgiveness for Professor Cheyne and a companion, asking these two free birds flight to the highest heaven; remembrance of named Western friends.

selected.text: Make that liberated servant, the destitute but melody-filled Husayn, and make this helpless servant his partner and companion.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for the destitute but melody-filled Husayn asking that “this helpless servant” be made his partner and companion; keeps the reciprocal voice of the opening.

selected.text: Thee through this prayer, perchance Thy trusted servants may become aware of my lamentations, may supplicate unto Thee on my behalf, and Thou wouldst graciously answer their prayers as a token of Thy grace
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: From the day that I left America I have ever supplicated God on thy behalf, begging for thee infinite protection and assurance
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that since leaving America He has ever supplicated God on the correspondent’s behalf; distance does not end remembrance.

selected.text: O maid-servant of God! Do beseech and pray constantly for 'Abdu'l-Baha and beg the confirmation and assistance of God in his behalf
selected.reason: Request of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a maidservant pray constantly for Him and beg God’s confirmation on His behalf; shows prayer flowing in both directions.

selected.text: O Thou Pure God! … Gaze providently at the beloved ones and the dear maid-servants in Chicago. Confer upon them Thy bounty and grace
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking God to gaze providently on the beloved ones and maidservants in Chicago; prayer for a named community.

selected.text: O Lord! Ordain for him and for Thy servants who have been deprived of meeting Thee the reward of those who have attained Thy presence
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O Lord! Make the Spiritual Assembly of Philadelphia the manifestation of divine confirmations and the dawning-place of merciful lights
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the Spiritual Assembly of Philadelphia become the manifestation of divine confirmations; prayer for an institution.

selected.text: For some time we stayed at the foot of Mount Carmel at the place of Elias, and day and night we remembered you and sought confirmation.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that while staying at the foot of Mount Carmel at the place of Elias He remembered the friends day and night; a narrative example of remembrance in a sacred place.

selected.text: I beseech the True One, exalted be His glory, to sanctify the orators of the world and adorn them with the ornament of knowledge and deeds.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh beseeching God to sanctify the orators of the world and adorn them with knowledge and deeds; prayer widened to all who speak.

selected.text: I pray for both of them, that in this noteworthy art may they become famous, that they may become accomplished masters in it, rare in quality.
selected.reason: Reported words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá praying that two people become famous and accomplished masters in their art; a distinctive prayer for artistic skill.

selected.text: This is Thy servant whom Thou hast brought forth from the loins of one of Thy loved ones and named Jalal (Glory) in the kingdom of Thy names
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for a servant brought forth from the loins of one of His loved ones and named Jalal; Bahá’u’lláh’s own prayer for a believer’s child.

selected.text: I have beseeched forgiveness from the Lord of Creation for your mother and asked for her comfort and ease. I hope this prayer will be accepted.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that He sought forgiveness for a correspondent’s mother and asked for her comfort and ease; care for a mother.

selected.text: and seek assistance and bounty from the spirituality of His Holiness Muhammad Mustafa the Messenger of God (peace be upon him), and pray for you
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá seeking assistance from the spirituality of Muhammad, the Messenger of God, while praying for the correspondent; a distinctive invocation that honors an earlier Prophet.

selected.text: say that we are always engaged in prayer for you, that God may confirm and assist you to be successful in great matters in service to that just king
selected.reason: Assurance of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the friends pray for a correspondent to succeed in great matters in service to a just king; prayer for public work.

selected.text: In the time of invocation to God, I remember thee and supplicate and entreat Him to confirm thee and assist thee in the service of His Holy vineyard.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that in the time of invocation He remembers the correspondent and asks that he be assisted in service of the Holy vineyard; prayer joined to work.

selected.text: O Lord! O Forgiver! Make this assured handmaiden of Yours, along with her children and descendants, firm and steadfast in Your Covenant and Testament.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a handmaiden, with her children and descendants, be firm in the Covenant; prayer reaching across generations.

selected.text: I carried a water jug on your behalf and, with your intention, offered it as a vessel for the heavenly fountain. May God accept it with gracious acceptance
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that He carried a water jug on the correspondent’s behalf and with that intention; a humble physical service offered for an absent friend.

selected.text: I have the utmost attachment to all the people of Nur, and I pray for heavenly confirmation, divine success, eternal glory and everlasting bounty for them
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá expressing utmost attachment to all the people of Nur and praying for their confirmation and everlasting bounty; affection for a whole place.

selected.text: Earnest supplications were offered at the threshold of the Gracious Lord on behalf of your illustrious son, that he may be assisted with mighty confirmation.
selected.reason: Report of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that earnest supplications were offered at the Threshold for a correspondent’s son, that he be assisted with mighty confirmation; prayer for a child.

selected.text: O my God! These are the five leaves from the tree of Thy mercy and the five handmaidens at the sacred threshold of Thy oneness … Verily, Thou art the Chooser
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for five leaves of the tree of mercy and five handmaidens at the threshold; a group of women remembered together.

selected.text: I pray for you, that divine confirmations may assist you and that you may study and be educated in such a way as to become the cause of joy to Aqa Mirza Ahmad.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a correspondent study and be educated so as to become the cause of joy to Aqa Mirza Ahmad; education as both blessing and responsibility.

selected.text: Since the day of my departure from Budapest I have been always remembering you and have begged from his holiness Baha'u'llah protection and providence for you
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that since leaving Budapest He has always remembered the correspondent and begged protection for them; remembrance after a visit.

selected.text: I offer utmost supplication to the Glorious Lord that relief may come … I will offer humble entreaty for them at the Divine Threshold and seek infinite favors
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá offering utmost supplication that relief may come and promising humble entreaty for those in difficulty; prayer in a time of strain.

selected.text: In Alexandria, with the utmost lowliness and need, I supplicate and implore at the Sacred Threshold and beseech for you the hidden favors of the Blessed Beauty.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that in Alexandria, with lowliness and need, He implores the hidden favors of the Blessed Beauty for the friends; places intercession in a named setting abroad.

selected.text: this prayer was offered with utmost humility and supplication, and surely signs of its acceptance in the Abha Kingdom have appeared and will continue to appear.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a prayer was offered with utmost humility and signs of its acceptance have appeared and will continue to appear; confidence in answered prayer.

selected.text: I supplicated to God in thy behalf that thou mayest become a strong growing tree, protected and guarded from the winds of tests and attain to heavenly guidance.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that He prayed that the correspondent become a strong growing tree protected from the winds of tests; a concise image of growth under trial.

selected.text: 'Abdu'l-Baha constantly implores and beseeches at the Divine Threshold that He may rid His friends of all concerns, and make them kind to both stranger and kin
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that He implores God to make the friends kind to both stranger and kin; practical widening of care.

selected.text: O kind Lord! Grant this household an eternal foundation and an everlasting establishment and make it blessed. Thou art the Bestower, the Giver, and the Kind One.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking an eternal foundation and lasting establishment for a household; concise prayer for a home.

selected.text: O Lord, protect her grandchild in the cave of Your protection and shelter, and guard the apple of her eye beneath the shadow of Your preservation and safekeeping
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a woman’s grandchild, the apple of her eye, be protected in the cave of God’s shelter; tender care across generations.

selected.text: it was decided that this servant would bow his head at the Sacred Threshold and supplicate and pray on your behalf as your deputy, and recite the Visitation Prayer
selected.reason: Account by ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that it was decided He would pray at the Sacred Threshold as the correspondent’s deputy and recite the Visitation Prayer; prayer as deputyship.

selected.text: O Haydar! The Wronged One hath made mention of thee from His Most Great Prison with a remembrance from which hath flowed the Water of Life for all contingent beings.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh that He mentioned Haydar from His prison with a remembrance from which flowed the Water of Life; the power of being remembered.

selected.text: I supplicated and implored at the Threshold of the Beauty of Abha, beseeching pardon, forgiveness and bounty of the Merciful for thee, thy friends and even thine enemies.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that He beseeched pardon, forgiveness and bounty for the correspondent, the friends and even the enemies; prayer for enemies.

selected.text: I will pray to God that you may become members of the heavenly assembly and pillars of the celestial parliament, for this station is eternal and has no end or separation.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that He will pray for the friends to become members of the heavenly assembly and pillars of the celestial parliament, a station without end; a hope beyond earthly membership.

selected.text: We beseech God to confirm thee even as He confirmed thy father, and through you both to open the doors of hearts. Verily He is the Powerful, the Mighty, the All-Bestowing.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh beseeching God to confirm a believer as He confirmed his father, and through both to open the doors of hearts; generations in service.

selected.text: O Pen! Make mention of him who hath been named Muhammad … Blessed is he who maketh mention of him and reciteth what We have revealed for him in this praiseworthy station
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh blessing whoever makes mention of a named believer and recites what was revealed for him; recitation as remembrance.

selected.text: We make mention at this moment of him who was named Siyyid 'Ali, that the breezes of My revelation may attract him and draw him nigh unto My glorious and wondrous Kingdom.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh making mention of Siyyid ‘Ali that the breezes of revelation may attract him and draw him nigh; mention itself as a means of drawing someone near.

selected.text: I beseech God to protect him on the path and bring him to the sacred precincts of the Glorious Sanctuary … I ask God to gladden the hearts of the believers through His grace
selected.reason: Words of the Báb beseeching God to protect a traveler on the path and bring him to the sacred precincts; prayer for one on a journey in the Báb’s own voice.

selected.text: 'Abdu'l-Baha, with utmost supplication and imploring, beseecheth this bounty for thee from the Court of Oneness, and longeth to be thy partner and associate in this service.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that He beseeches a bounty for the correspondent and longs to be their partner and associate in this service; reciprocity in service.

selected.text: This is one of Your maidservants and a leaf from the leaves of Your tree of mercy … My Lord! Aid her in the desert of separation from You and the intensity of her deprivation
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a maidservant, asking aid in the desert of separation and the intensity of her deprivation; prayer for a woman in hardship.

selected.text: We beseech God, blessed and exalted be He, to make him one who drinks from the cup of certitude at all times and to ordain for him that which will exalt him among the religions
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh beseeching that a believer drink from the cup of certitude and be exalted among the religions; one person’s faith set among the religions.

selected.text: O Knower of mysteries! Make each of the Persians a soaring bird, melodious and sweet-voiced. Grant them heavenly shahnaz and make them royal falcons on the arm of the sovereign
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that each of the Persians become a soaring, sweet-voiced bird and a royal falcon; a vivid image of prayer for a people.

selected.text: We beseech God, glorified be His majesty, on behalf of each one, for blessing and bounty and health and protection and well-being and recognition and certitude and steadfastness.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh beseeching for each one blessing, health, protection, well-being, recognition, certitude and steadfastness; a compact petition joining outer and inner needs.

selected.text: Every morning I rise from my bed thinking of you, and every evening I raise a melody of supplication and entreaty to the Abha Kingdom, beseeching confirmation and success for you.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that He rises every morning thinking of the friend and every evening raises a supplication for that person’s success; the morning-and-evening remembrance the questions recall.

selected.text: O Lord! Grant them success in every good deed among the chosen ones, and let Thy grace and favor encompass even the strangers. Verily, Thou art the All-Bountiful, the All-Choosing.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that God’s grace and favor encompass even the strangers; the circle widening beyond the community.

selected.text: I will beseech God that it may be facilitated, so that you may become an intermediary stringing together the pearls among the friends, and shine forth with the light of God's favor
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a correspondent become an intermediary stringing together the pearls among the friends; a memorable image of fostering unity.

selected.text: Convey, on my behalf, the utmost longing to the believers of Montreal. I remember them always and seek confirmation and assistance from the bounty of the Holy Spirit on their behalf.
selected.reason: Message of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá conveying longing to the believers of Montreal and assuring them He remembers them always; prayer for a distant community.

selected.text: We remember Nasir and Abbas and pray for their success and support from the presence of the Helper, the Wise. We send greetings upon him and upon Abdul-Karim and upon those with you.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh remembering Nasir and Abbas, praying for their success and sending greetings to named others; keeps His own voice in the remembered names.

selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that day and night He supplicates for a community so that their city may become the envy of all the cities of the world; prayer with a civic horizon.

selected.text: The blessed leaf, Khalih Khanum, mentions thee at all times in the gathering of the Merciful, remembers thee in the meetings of fellowship, and offers prayers for thee in the Holy Shrine
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a named woman mentions the correspondent at all times and prays for the correspondent at the Holy Shrine; intercession by a woman.

selected.text: O Lord! Make firm her root in Thy Covenant, strengthen her trunk through Thy grace, reinforce her tree through Thy sovereignty, and rear her beneath the shade of the tree of Thy oneness.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to make firm a woman’s root in the Covenant, strengthen her trunk and rear her beneath the tree of oneness; the tree image applied to one person’s growth.

selected.text: I beseech the favors of divine bestowal that Mr. Weirs may become attracted to the divine Kingdom and be so enkindled with the fire of the love of God that he may illuminate that region.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá beseeching that a named man become attracted to the Kingdom and illumine his region; prayer for one who may yet believe.

selected.text: O Lord my God! This is a servant who is related to Your servant who was banished and exiled in Your path to the land of Sudan … make him a sign of Your beneficence, a banner of Your bounty
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a relative of one banished and exiled to Sudan in God’s path; keeps the history of exile behind a personal prayer.

selected.text: Verily God has forgiven thy father and thy mother. He is indeed the Forgiver, the Mighty, the Generous. … Rejoice thou in thy Lord's favor, then render thanks unto Him at morn and eventide
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh that God has forgiven the correspondent’s father and mother, with the call to give thanks morn and eventide; assurance for the bereaved.

My Lord, cause them to inhale the fragrance of the All-Merciful from the holy place that perfumes all existence. My Lord, make them signs of Thy mercy and banners of Thy bounty and lamps
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for two servants who hastened to Yathrib and Batha and dwelt near the Sacred Mosque, that they become signs of mercy; prayer for pilgrims to the holy places of Islam.

selected.text: I hope that Rahim will be successful in his studies at school, and I pray to God that arrangements may be made for you to be enabled to visit the Holy Threshold before returning to America.
selected.reason: Hope of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a boy succeed in his studies at school and that the family may visit the Holy Threshold before returning to America; a practical blessing and the postponed-pilgrimage theme.

selected.text: O Thou Forgiving Lord! Shed Thy Radiance upon these servants of Thine and give unto them a melodious voice in the Rose-garden of the Most High! Make them the musicians of the Heavenly Feast.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to give servants a melodious voice and make them the musicians of the Heavenly Feast; a distinctive image of gifts.

selected.text: O my God, my God! Thou knowest the intensity of my longing and my great attachment to this servant who is firm in the Covenant and who has grown through the outpouring of the cloud of bounty.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá declaring the intensity of His longing and attachment to a servant firm in the Covenant; personal love voiced in prayer.

selected.text: O Husayn! Rejoice in that thy name hath flowed from My Most Exalted Pen while the Wronged One was in this remote spot … Make mention of him who was named Hadi, that he may rejoice in My mention
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh telling Husayn to rejoice that his name has flowed from the Most Exalted Pen in a remote spot, and asking mention of Hadi; remembrance as a gift that gladdens.

selected.text: O Lord! O Lord! Ordain for her every good in Thy Kingdom, look upon her with the glances of Thy merciful eye, and admit her to the eternal Paradise when she ascendeth to the kingdom of Thy unity
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a woman, asking every good in His Kingdom and admittance to eternal Paradise when she ascends; prayer reaching beyond this life.

selected.text: And I, on my own behalf and as a representative of yourself, circumambulate the two blessed burial places, visit the two purified tombs, and rub my face in the dust of the two illumined thresholds
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that on His own behalf and as the correspondent’s representative He circumambulates the two blessed burial places; prayer at the Shrines for an absent friend.

selected.text: Miss Jean Masson who is writing by 'Abdu'l-Baha's command an answer to the Wilson Book, sends her love to the Master, and begs his assistance in this difficult task
selected.reason: Pilgrim report that a believer writing, by ‘Abdu’l-Bahá’s command, an answer to a published book begs His assistance in the difficult task; a scholarly labor carried into prayer.

selected.text: O Lord! Transform the losses of Thy loved ones into the greatest gain, then set right their affairs through Thy grace, O Thou Who art the Lord of eternity and Who art manifest through the Most Great Name.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that the losses of His loved ones be transformed into the greatest gain and their affairs set right; relief from loss.

selected.text: O Thou kind Lord! This daughter of the Kingdom hath made a great exertion and hath written down the addresses of 'Abdu'l-Baha. O Lord! Assist her and her daughters to spread abroad the splendours of the Kingdom.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a daughter of the Kingdom who made great exertion in writing down His addresses, and for her daughters; a specific labor remembered in prayer.

selected.text: O 'Ali! Do not despair of God's spirit and mercy, and grieve not over anything in the days of God, the Lord of the mighty throne. Be content with what has been ordained and fix thy gaze upon the Supreme Horizon
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh to ‘Ali not to despair of God’s mercy nor grieve, but to be content and fix his gaze on the Supreme Horizon; counsel that comforts.

selected.text: Abdul-Baha's hope is that those kind friends will all share and participate with Abdul-Baha in servitude at the Threshold of the All-Merciful. We are all servants at that Court and worshippers at that Threshold.
selected.reason: Hope of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that kind friends share with Him in servitude at the Threshold, “We are all servants at that Court”; grounds reciprocal prayer in shared servitude.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O my God, at this moment, by the radiant lights of Thy countenance and the dawning-places of the Sun of Thy oneness, that Thou send Thy blessings upon Thy Proof, son of Thy Proof, Ali ibn Musa
selected.reason: Prayer of the Báb sending blessings upon Ali ibn Musa, the Proof and son of the Proof; keeps a named Imam within the Báb’s own invocation.

selected.text: My hope is that the prayer will be answered and boundless bounty will be attained and the confirmation of the Lord of Lords will arrive and each one will be confirmed in comprehensive utterances and decisive speech
selected.reason: Hope of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that prayer will be answered and each be confirmed in comprehensive utterances and decisive speech; prayer for truthful speech.

selected.text: My God! Thou knowest that the two most noble Names did not seek to gather worldly goods nor acquire the ornaments of this abode of sorrows, but rather sought to dwell near Thee and spread Thy remembrance and praise.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá testifying that two believers did not seek worldly goods but to dwell near God and spread His praise; puts their material circumstances in spiritual light.

selected.text: O my God, my God! This servant of Thine has spent all that he could in Thy path. O Lord! Send down upon him a blessing from Thy presence and assist him through Thy power and might. Verily Thou art the Generous One.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a servant who has spent all he could in God’s path, asking blessing and assistance; prayer for one who has given materially.

selected.text: O Lord! I beseech Thee with all humility, supplication, imploring and contrition to assist every servant who arises to serve Thy Cause, and every one enkindled with the fire of Thy love who strives to exalt Thy Word
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá with all humility to assist every servant who arises to serve the Cause and exalt the Word; prayer widening to all who serve.

selected.text: O my God! I traveled through wildernesses and crossed seas until I reached the realm of light, where I became a resident at Thy threshold and sought shelter in Thy court. … O Lord! Forgive my sins and awaken my heart and soul
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá in first person of one who crossed wildernesses and seas to reach the Threshold and now asks forgiveness and awakening; words a reader may carry into prayer.

selected.text: the kingdom of earth and heavens, to send Thy blessings upon Muhammad ibn 'Ali, Thy Proof and son of Thy Proof, with the most excellent blessings Thou hast ever sent upon any of Thy chosen ones or bestowed upon any of Thy sincere ones. And cause, O my God, his heart to be well-pleased with Thee
selected.reason: Prayer of the Báb sending blessings upon Muhammad ibn ‘Ali and asking that his heart be well pleased with God; another Imam invoked in the Báb’s words.

selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for a handmaiden who has appeared before His throne seeking His grace, asking that she be made content and well-pleasing; keeps a particular petition in His own voice.

selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for souls descended from Abraham and eminent among Israel, asking shelter, gifts and tranquility; prayer reaching across religious background.

selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for one who emigrated from his homeland out of love for meeting God; prayer for an emigrant.

selected.text: O God! O Thou Who givest life to the world and educates the nations! I beseech Thee by Thy Greatest Name to cast tranquility into the heart of Thy servant Hatam Muhammad, that his heart may find peace in Thy irrevocable Cause
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a named servant’s heart find tranquility and peace in God’s Cause; inner peace as a gift asked for another.

selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking that a named servant be aided to bring forth righteous offspring; hope for future generations.

selected.text: O Lord! Make the parents of the attracted leaf Kawkab Sultan the manifestation of pardon and forgiveness and exalt them through endless favors. Grant them free forgiveness and pardon and bestow upon them nearness to Your Threshold.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the parents of a named woman be made manifestations of pardon and brought near the Threshold; prayer on behalf of a believer’s parents.

selected.text: O Lord! Aid Thy loved ones and Thy branches in that which beseemeth them in Thy days, then write down for them the reward of those who have circled round Thy Will and quaffed the choice wine of revelation from the hand of Thy bounty.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to aid His loved ones and His branches in what beseems them in His days; the language of branches in His own prayer.

selected.text: O peerless Lord! Make Dinyar Bahram joyous and grant him rest in the shade of the tree of pardon and forgiveness. Turn his night into day and make his day victorious, that he may find shelter in the proximity of the Most Great Mercy.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a named man rest in the shade of the tree of pardon and that his night be turned into day; a memorable image of consolation.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O Thou the Beloved of Baha, to ordain for her the reward of those who have outwardly entered the pavilion of Thy grandeur, heard the melodies of Thy transcendent unity, and drunk from Thy hand the Kawthar of Thy mercy.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking that a woman be granted the reward of those who outwardly entered His presence and drank from His hand; addresses those unable to attain the presence.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O my Lord, by Thy Name which Thou hast made to be the Day-Spring of Thy Revelation and the Dawning-Place of Thine inspiration, to ordain for this wronged One and for them that are dear to Thee what becometh Thy loftiness.
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: I am, night and day, engaged in remembering you, and happy with your thought, and ask the Lord of the Kingdom for confirmation, that He may make each one of you a sign of guidance and the means of educating and guiding other women and men.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that night and day He remembers the friends and prays they become means of educating and guiding other women and men; remembrance turned toward education.

selected.text: O my God, my God! Aid Thy servants to manifest such virtues as Thou hast ordained for Thy loved ones, and to walk in such paths as Thou hast chosen for Thy trusted ones, that they may treat all humanity with utmost truthfulness and love
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that servants manifest virtues so they treat all humanity with utmost truthfulness and love; the guide’s closing aim.

selected.text: from beginning to end expressing supplication, entreaty and attraction to the Kingdom of Glory. I have little time and write briefly. Show the utmost kindness on my behalf to Jinab-i-Ustad Muhammad Hasan-i-Banna. I beseech abundant favors for him and seek the forgiveness of the All-Forgiving Lord. selected.reason: Letter of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá noting He has little time and writes briefly, yet asking kindness for one friend and forgiveness and joy for others; carries the letters written despite exhaustion.

selected.text: Tomorrow, Friday, specifically on your behalf, a prayer of visitation will be chanted with all the friends in the Holy Shrine. And since the gathering will be large and all will be representing you, it will count as a hundred visits for you.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a prayer of visitation will be chanted with all the friends on the correspondent’s behalf and will count as a hundred visits; distinctive account of a gathering representing one person.

selected.text: My God, my God! Verily Your servant Mahdi has arisen before Your exalted threshold and beseeches the Kingdom of the All-Merciful, hoping for confirmation from the Righteous Support for himself, his companion, his mother and those related to him
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a servant seeking confirmation for himself, his companion, his mother and his relatives; kinship remembered in one petition.

selected.text: In the Holy Garden, may my spirit be sacrificed for its pure threshold, forgiveness and pardon were sought from the Lord God, and likewise support and confirmation were beseeched for your honor and the children and ladies mentioned in the letter.
selected.reason: Report of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that in the Holy Garden pardon was sought and support beseeched for the correspondent and the children and ladies named in the letter; family members remembered by name.

selected.text: O Lord! Ordain for him every good thing in Thy kingdom, and assist him, as long as he liveth, to transcribe Thy verses and compose Thy words. Protect him within the shelter of Thy protection, and guard him beneath the eye of Thy care and preservation.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a scribe be assisted as long as he lives to transcribe God’s verses; skilled work offered as service.

selected.text: This servant will supplicate and implore at the Threshold of the One, seeking forgiveness on behalf of the honored Lari, beseeching pardon and forgiveness. I hope that the ocean of forgiveness will surge forth and wash away the stains of disobedience.
selected.reason: Promise of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to seek forgiveness for a named man, hoping the ocean of forgiveness will wash away the stains of disobedience; intercession for forgiveness.

selected.text: My Lord and my Hope! This is Thy servant, a branch of the Tree which was uprooted in Thy path by the hands of Thine enemies … Make this branch a root, and this twig a tree growing, thriving, verdant, fresh and flourishing in the gardens of Thy oneness
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a branch of a family tree uprooted by enemies, asking that this branch become a root and a flourishing tree; continuance after persecution.

selected.text: O ye illustrious Afnan! A few months ago, a prayer was revealed beseeching protection and divine favors for all the Afnan of the sanctified Tree and praising the qualities of the offshoots of the sacred Tree, but news of its arrival hath not been received.
selected.reason: Letter of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to the Afnan noting that a prayer for their protection was revealed months ago but news of its arrival has not come; keeps a source gap and the reality of delayed letters.

selected.text: O God, my God! These are Thy servants whom the breezes of the gardens of Thy mercy have stirred, and the waves from the fountains of Thy oneness have refreshed … Aid them to serve Thy Cause and join them with Thy servant in servitude at Thy exalted threshold
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for servants refreshed by God’s mercy, asking that they be joined with Him in servitude at the threshold; returns to shared servitude.

selected.text: You had written asking that through divine grace you might be protected from the evil of the commanding self. This prayer 'Abdu'l-Baha constantly utters for himself. I hope that both you and I may remain safe and protected in the shelter of divine protection.
selected.reason: Letter of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá answering a request for protection from the commanding self by saying He constantly utters this prayer for Himself and hopes both writer and He remain protected; the guide’s opening gesture of shared need.

selected.text: I prayed to the Kingdom of existence and beseeched for divine assistance and bounties, that Mr. Carl Gohring may achieve success in his medical practice and that both of you may be confirmed in service to the oneness of mankind and the worship of the True One.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá praying that a named man succeed in his medical practice and that both spouses serve the oneness of mankind; a profession and service held together.

selected.text: O God! Protect Thy servants from drinking wine and prevent them from intoxicants. O Lord! Remove this affliction from the face of the earth until no trace of intoxicants remains and no mention of smoking tobacco is heard. Thou art the Mighty and the Powerful.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to protect His servants from wine and intoxicants and remove this affliction from the earth; a distinctive practical petition.

selected.text: We beseech God to forgive thy father and to send down upon him at all times a blessing from His presence and a mercy from His side, and to make him hear His verses and behold the mysteries of His dominion and kingdom. He is verily the Mighty
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh beseeching God to forgive a correspondent’s father and make him hear His verses; prayer for a parent’s forgiveness.

selected.text: I beseech God to make the end of your life the beginning of favors, and to confirm your two distinguished sons, the comfort of your eyes, as two brilliant stars in the horizon of glory
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá beseeching God to make the end of a correspondent’s life the beginning of favors and to confirm his two sons; hope for life’s close and for posterity.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O Lord, by his right, to send peace upon Him Who stands by Thy Cause in His station in fulfillment throughout the worlds of creation, Who is obeyed in the spheres of attributes and names, Who is unique in His station of obedience above all mankind
selected.reason: Prayer of the Báb beseeching peace upon Him Who stands by God’s Cause and is obeyed in the spheres of attributes and names; the Báb’s sacred remembrance.

selected.text: Regarding those whose names thou hast written, I ask aid and assistance for them from God, especially … I beseech at the Threshold of the Oneness of God to shower upon him blessings and open upon him the door of guidance, bestowing upon his heart the heavenly light
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking aid for all those whose names the correspondent has written, especially one for whom He seeks guidance; prayer for names sent in a letter.

selected.text: I beseech Thee … to bless the steps of Thy handmaiden whom Thou hast named Neshat-Angiz by Thy wondrous and mighty Pen among Thy chosen ones and loved ones. Then make her a sign of Thy mercy among Thy handmaidens and a manifestation of Thy grace among Thy creatures
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to bless the steps of a handmaiden He named, making her a sign of His mercy among His handmaidens; naming and blessing a woman.

selected.text: My God, my God! Aid Thy servant Mahdi through Thy forgiveness and pardon, cause him to enter the paradise of Thy oneness, give him to drink from the cup of meeting Thee from the hand of Thy mercy, and grant him the heavenly table of bestowal through Thy grace and favor.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a named servant to be aided through forgiveness and pardon and to enter the paradise of oneness; a concise prayer for forgiveness.

selected.text: Lord! Make him speak with a brilliant proof, a radiant evidence, a conclusive argument and overwhelming power, so that Thy distinguishing word may be fulfilled: "Truth has come and falsehood has perished," and there is no doubt that the false word is ephemeral and base
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a servant speak with brilliant proof so that the word “Truth has come and falsehood has perished” be fulfilled; prayer for truthful speech.

selected.text: We have heard thy call and, having accepted thy turning unto Us, have made mention of thee in such wise that the fragrance thereof shall endure throughout the eternity of the Most Beautiful Names of God. Be thou thankful for this and say: "Praise be unto Thee, O
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh that He heard a believer’s call and mentioned him so that its fragrance endures, inviting him to give thanks; the invitation to pray.

selected.text: My God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having remembered me in Thy Most Great Prison, and thanksgiving be unto Thee for having revealed unto me that which shall endure as long as Thy dominion and Thy kingdom, Thy glory and Thy sovereignty shall endure, O God of the worlds!
selected.reason: Words of thanksgiving in a Tablet of Bahá’u’lláh, “Praise be unto Thee for having remembered me in Thy Most Great Prison”; gratitude for being remembered.

selected.reason: Request of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a prayer be recited on His behalf at the Holy Shrine with weeping and supplication, and that hearers beg its acceptance; reciprocal prayer at the close.

selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to assist His handmaiden and leaf that her mention may endure in His kingdom; a woman remembered by Bahá’u’lláh.

selected.text: O my Lord, what a lofty palace You have established for Your loved ones … nurture this family with the spring rains of Your mercy and preserve them in the cave of Your protection and shelter from tests and trials. Keep them firm in the Covenant and detach them from Satan's wiles
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to nurture a family with the spring rains of mercy and preserve them from tests and trials; family blessing joined to protection.

selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for two servants who are protectors of the poor and helpers of the weak; the helpers of the vulnerable remembered in prayer.

selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for an afflicted servant who never ceases to remember the loved ones at eventide and dawn, that he be made steadfast; the afflicted one himself as intercessor.

selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for a believer and those who sought God, asking the good of this world and the next and that they circle round the Kaaba of His Cause; a complete petition for seekers.

selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that a named servant be so enkindled that through him the inhabitants of God’s lands be set ablaze; one person’s love becoming influence.

selected.reason: Supplication of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the beloved in Cincinnati glow with the fire of Sinai, meek and lowly, denying self and grasping the robe of piety; character as fruit of prayer.

selected.text: Thou seest one of Thy Afnan circling round Thy will and turning unto Thee when most of Thy servants have turned away from Thee. I beseech Thee, O my Lord, by Thy Name through which Thou hast subdued all created things, to transform his sorrow into supreme joy and his loss into greatest gain.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for one of the Afnan who turned to God when most turned away, asking that his sorrow become supreme joy and his loss greatest gain; consolation in grief.

selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for His sister to be steadfast in God’s love and dwell under the Tree of His bounty that her heart be assured; a family prayer in His own voice.

selected.text: O Lord! Thou witnesseth his arising to serve Thee, his praise of Thy Self, and his turning towards the ocean of Thy grace. Send down upon him from the heaven of Thy bounty that which shall cause him to endure through the endurance of Thy most beautiful names and Thy most exalted attributes. selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for one who arose to serve, asking that he transcribe God’s verses and spread His commandments; a vocation of service.

selected.text: I supplicate to God that He may confirm thy noble son in the attainment of arts (and sciences … I pray ardently for them to the Threshold of Oneness and implore help and boundless Blessing for them … I am soliciting God that their dear child may be favored with growth, development and safety
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá praying that a noble son be confirmed in the attainment of arts and sciences and that a dear child be favored with growth and safety; education within the family.

selected.text: O Lord, O Lord! I beseech Thee to grant the friends in Shahrud access to the flowing waters, assist them with bountiful aid, give them to drink from the pure cup, and bestow upon them abundant gifts, inasmuch as they have turned to the Center of Light and the Dawning-Place of the Manifestation
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for the friends in Shahrud to receive flowing waters and abundant gifts; prayer for a named town.

selected.text: My God, my God! These are servants who have turned toward the Kingdom of Thy sanctity from the most distant lands, far-reaching regions and remote places, supplicating to Thee at morn and eventide, relying upon Thee in all matters and conditions, imploring the might of Thy mercy at eve and dawn.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for servants who have turned to God from the most distant lands, supplicating morn and eventide; distance and devotion in a community.

selected.text: O My leaf! Turn to the Most Exalted Horizon, then hearken to the call of thy Lord, the Lord of Names. He calleth thee and giveth thee glad tidings of God's loving-kindness and grace, for thy son Husayn was present before the Wronged One. Verily thy Lord is the All-Compassionate, the All-Bountiful.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh telling a mother of God’s loving-kindness because her son Husayn was present before the Wronged One; a parent gladdened through a child.

selected.text: his honor Mirza Sadiq Khan. They are in mind and before our sight. I beseech God that they may become a lamp lit with the light of guidance and the cause of others
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that named friends are in mind and before His sight, with the hope that they become lamps of guidance and the cause of others’ guidance; remembrance that looks to service.

selected.text: O two servants of Truth! In this moment I am offering prayers at the Threshold of the One God, the Most Great Name, saying: "O Lord! Make these two precious souls intimate companions with Thy remembrance, and guide these two longing hearts to the rose-garden of inner meanings and realities. Lead these two fish to the sweet waters of guidance, and bring these two gazelles of the desert of unity to the meadow of Thy bounty
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá giving the prayer He offers for two souls, asking that these two fish reach sweet waters and two gazelles reach the meadow; vivid imagery with its setting.

selected.text: These Alvar servants of Thine are enamored of Thy countenance and enthralled by Thy locks, intoxicated by Thy chalice and addicted to the wine of Thy eternal tavern. They are caught in Thy snare and are nightingales at Thy dawn. They are flowers of Thy meadow and grass by the stream of Thy rose garden.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá describing a group of servants as nightingales at God’s dawn and grass by the stream of His rose garden; distinctive mystical imagery for a named group.

selected.text: O Lord! They have borne every abasement in Thy path - make them mighty in Thy Kingdom. They have endured every hardship in Thy love - grant them comfort and joy in Thy holy court. They have fallen under the derision of enemies and the blame of the wicked - make them signs of Thy glory among all peoples
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for those who bore every abasement and hardship and the derision of enemies, that they be made mighty and joyful; persecution answered by prayer.

selected.text: O Lord! This is Your servant who has turned to the light of Your mercifulness and has been attracted by the fragrances from the gardens of Your oneness. He has spent his spirit, his body, his dwelling and his house in Your path and has detached himself from all things, aflame with the fire of Your love.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a servant who spent his spirit, body, dwelling and house in God’s path; sacrifice remembered before God.

selected.text: O Hatim, upon thee be the glory of God, the Lord of eternity! Thy mention hath been made in the presence of the Wronged One, and this most sublime and wondrous Tablet hath been sent down especially for thee from the heaven of divine Will, that thine eyes may be consoled thereby and thy heart may rejoice.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh that a Tablet was sent down especially for a named believer that his eyes be consoled and his heart rejoice; a Tablet as personal consolation.

selected.text: I beseech Thee not to disappoint me of that which Thou hast ordained for such of Thy servants as are sincere … O my Lord! Strengthen him and Thy handmaiden who hath believed in Thee and in Thy signs, that through them Thy remembrance may be exalted amongst Thy servants and Thy Cause amongst Thy creation
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking to strengthen a man and a believing handmaiden that through them God’s remembrance be exalted; prayer for a couple’s service.

selected.text: Verily, Thy servant Abu'l-Qasim shares with Thy loved ones the outpourings of Thy mercy, and I swear by Thy resplendent Beauty that he strives to serve Thy servants throughout the worlds, that Thy verses may be spread abroad, Thy evidences become manifest, and Thy words penetrate the hearts of the seekers.
selected.reason: Testimony of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a named servant strives to serve God’s servants throughout the worlds; prayer joined to praise of service.

selected.text: O Kind Lord! Keep Your handmaiden Qudsiyyih protected and preserved under the shelter of Your grace and bounty, place upon her head a brilliant crown from Your greatest gift, make her honored in both worlds, and make her the cause of eternal honor for that family. You are the Bestower, the Luminous, and the Kind.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a named handmaiden be protected, crowned and made the cause of eternal honor for her family; one person’s blessing as a family good.

selected.text: O My handmaiden and My leaf! Say: Glory be to Thee, O Lord of all dominion and Protector of the downtrodden! I beseech Thee by what Thou hast ordained in Thy celestial kingdom and Thy realm of might, to inscribe for this Thy leaf, by Thy Most Exalted Pen, that which will tranquilize her soul and dilate her breast.
selected.reason: Prayer given by Bahá’u’lláh to a handmaiden, asking what will tranquilize her soul and dilate her breast; a woman given words to pray.

selected.text: O Thou Almighty! Illumine Thou this Association and make Thou this gathering the bright candle of the world! For their intention is for the public good and their aim is Service to humankind. … O kind and compassionate God! Such a Society merits Thy Favors and such a Body deserves inexhaustible Bounty and Providence
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for an association whose intention is the public good and whose aim is service to humankind; a prayer for a collective work of service.

selected.text: O Lord! These are a blessed family who have become related to the Tree of Thy Oneness and connected to the Tree of Thy Unity. Assist them to attain exalted nobility, mighty glory and wondrous bounty, that their trees may become verdant, their flowers bloom and their fruits reach perfection in the season of spring.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a blessed family related to the Tree of Oneness, that their trees grow verdant and their fruits reach perfection; links family blessing to growth.

selected.text: O Lord! Thou seest Thy servant Nabil, the traveler, in the hands of the tyrannical among Thy servants. I beseech Thee, O God of Names and Creator of heaven, to assist him in all conditions to serve Thee, to make him a champion of Thy Cause, and steadfast in carrying out what Thou hast willed through Thy sovereignty.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for Nabil the traveler in the hands of the tyrannical, asking that he be steadfast in service; prayer for one under oppression.

selected.text: I beseech God to grant them confirmation and success, and to bring all the Parsees beneath the shadow of the celestial Standard, that the banner of truth may wave over all the people of that land, and that they may show forth such vigor and movement as to gladden the spirits of their forebears in the highest heaven.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that all the Parsees be brought beneath the celestial Standard and gladden the spirits of their forebears; prayer for a religious community and its ancestors.

selected.text: I, therefore, supplicate God to confirm thy glorious children, Frederick, Robert, and Herbert, to surround them with the glances of His merciful eye, to direct them to the path of guidance and to make them enter the Ark of Safety which is cleaving the sea of this contingent world in the midst of the deluge of tests
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for three named children to enter the Ark of Safety cleaving the sea amid a deluge of tests; a memorable image of protection for the next generation.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O my God, to make him and those with him Thy trustees in Thy lands and Thy signs among Thy creation. And we beseech Thee to name him in the Book of Names "The Exalted" that those with him may rejoice thereby. Then ordain for them, O my God, what Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones and Thy loved ones.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to make a believer and those with him God’s trustees, and to name him “The Exalted”; trust and naming.

selected.text: O Lord! Ordain for him what Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones who have attained the river of reunion in Thy days and who heard with their own ears Thy call when they were present before the Throne by Thy leave and command. Then forgive him, O my God, through Thy bounty and bestowals, and grant him what he desires.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh asking for one person what was ordained for the chosen ones who heard His call before the Throne, and forgiveness through His bounty; holds pilgrimage and forgiveness together.

selected.text: I remained in this sacred land and conveyed greetings on behalf of the aforementioned owners in the presence of the Prophet - peace be upon him and his family - and the pure Imams - peace be upon them. I am hopeful through the grace and beneficence of my Lord that they have accepted it out of their generosity and bounty.
selected.reason: Words of the Báb that He conveyed greetings on behalf of others in the presence of the Prophet and the Imams and hopes they were accepted; keeps the Báb’s voice in prayer on another’s behalf.

selected.text: O Lord! O Forgiver of sins! Make Tuba a bird of the Tuba tree and grant it a nest and dwelling in the Sadrat'ul-Muntaha. Make it harmonious with divine melody in the infinite garden so that it may become intimate with prayer and supplication and forever sing with the melody of the Concourse on High in that garden of eternity.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that Tuba become a bird of the Tuba tree, intimate with prayer and singing with the Concourse on High; a memorable prayer for a woman.

selected.text: Blessed is he who hath loved thee and loveth thee, and who hath heard from thee the verses of God, the Lord of the worlds. Thou art he whose heart We have adorned with My love, whose tongue with My remembrance, whose eyes with beholding My horizon, whose hand with taking My Book, and whose feet with steadfastness in My Cause.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh describing one whose heart, tongue, eyes, hand and feet He has adorned with love, remembrance and steadfastness; a portrait of character.

selected.text: of the Court of Baha! Thy letter was received and read, and supplications were offered at the Holy Threshold of the Ancient Beauty and the Most Great Name, that a fresh confirmation may reach thee, a speedy recovery be granted, and the Beloved of thy desire may appear in the utmost beauty and grace. And upon thee be the Most Glorious Glory
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that supplications were offered for a correspondent’s fresh confirmation and speedy recovery; prayer for one who is ill.

selected.text: O heavenly Glory of the world! O King of the realm of the All-Merciful! O my Beloved and my Purpose! O my Worshipped One and my Adored One! This broken-winged bird whom You enabled to soar - grant it wings and feathers. And this ailing person whom You charged with such a weighty trust - bestow upon him power and strength
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking wings for a broken-winged bird and strength for an ailing person charged with a weighty trust; a memorable image of vulnerability carried to God.

selected.text: O Lord! That kind mother is dear - make her successful and confirmed in Thy good-pleasure, give her to drink from the Salsabil of bounty, let her taste from the cup of oneness, make her intoxicated with the wine of 'Am I not?', exalt her at the feast of the Abha Kingdom, and make her successful in attaining the highest horizon.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a kind mother to be confirmed and exalted at the feast of the Abhá Kingdom; care for a parent expressed in prayer.

selected.text: my God! With utter lowliness and fervour, humility and devotion, I implore Thee with my tongue and my heart, with my spirit and my soul, and with my mind and my conscience, to grant the most cherished of all desires, destine the most meritorious of all deeds, and ordain all honour and perfection, favour and beauty, prosperity and salvation for this family
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O Lord! Hold me not accountable for attempting expression and exposition, and punish me not for forgetting my helplessness, lowliness and abasement in this field. Leave me not to myself, for it is sinful and plunged in the depths of rebellion. Abandon me not to my own devices, submerged in the seas of heedlessness and transgression.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking not to be held accountable for attempting expression or for forgetting His helplessness, “Leave me not to myself”; humility in the one who prays.

selected.text: My God, my God! This is a servant who has been set ablaze with the fire of Your love, attracted by the holy fragrances of Your presence, who has prayed fervently to You and beseeched at the gate of Your oneness that You encompass his father with the glances of Your merciful eyes, immerse him in the seas of Your pardon and forgiveness
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá describing a servant who prayed fervently that his father be immersed in pardon and forgiveness; a child’s intercession for a parent.

selected.text: O Muhammad-Qabli-Hasan! Praise the Goal of the world Who remembers thee in the Most Great Prison. Say: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, and thanksgiving be unto Thee, O my Glory! I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy Kingdom and the mysteries of Thy Dominion to ordain for me that which will make me a banner of Thy Name amongst Thy servants.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh telling a named believer to praise God Who remembers him and giving him a prayer to say; the invitation to recite with its recipient intact.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O my God, to send Thy blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and to do with me what is worthy of Thee, for Thou art the Lord of righteousness and the Lord of forgiveness, and to cause all who have believed in Thee and in Thy signs and who seek Thy good-pleasure to enter the kingdom of Thy grace and Thy glory.
selected.reason: Prayer of the Báb for the beginning of Safar asking blessings on Muhammad and His family and that all believers enter the kingdom of grace; the Báb’s prayer for all who believe.

selected.text: My God, my God! This is a servant who has been illumined by the guiding lights shining from the Sun of Truth and has been enlightened by the Lamp kindled in the Glass of the All-Merciful. O Lord! Illumine his face with the light of bounty and expand his breast through the verses of faithfulness, and make him a goodly example to all humanity.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that an illumined servant be made a goodly example to all humanity; character as example.

selected.text: The senses of the people of Baha are assuredly perfumed through the pure fragrance exhaled from the Garden of thine heart. Verily, I read those beautiful words traced by thy pen and asked God to make thee a sign of the Signs of His Power amongst His girls, to cause thee to be an emblem of this great Century, to strengthen thee in speech and explanation, to make thee attain the visit of the Holy Threshold and to enable thy father and mother in whatever conduces to salvation and life until the eternity of the eternities
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá praying that a young woman become a sign among girls, be strengthened in speech, attain the Holy Threshold and that her parents be enabled; a woman’s capacities and family together.

selected.text: Therefore shower upon her the glances of Thy merciful eye, adorn her with the ornament of the traces of Thy mercy, crown her head with the crown of those who have attained Thy presence and taken shelter in Thy vicinity, and accept from her this table which she hath spread for Thy loved ones. Verily Thou art the All-Generous, the All-Merciful.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking God to accept from a woman the table she has spread for His loved ones; hospitality offered and blessed in prayer.

selected.text: I pray for divine forgiveness for Jinab-i-Siyyid 'Ali-Muhammad and that he may be immersed in the ocean of grace and bounty … I pray for the teacher of the Tarbiyat School and seek spiritual progress for the children … I seek a ray of divine favors for the maidservant of God Ruhiyyih and protection and assistance from the All-Merciful for all
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá praying for forgiveness for one departed, for the teacher of the Tarbiyat School and spiritual progress of the children, and for a named maidservant; links prayer to education.

selected.text: O Habihu'llah! We have answered thee and made mention of thee in this perspicuous Tablet. We have named the heavenly table "Mary" as a token of Our favor and a mercy from Our presence. We beseech God to bless her coming and to rain down upon her from the clouds of His grace the showers of His blessing, His bounty, His generosity and His gifts
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh that He has named the heavenly table “Mary” as a token of favor and beseeches God to bless her coming; a distinctive blessing at a new arrival in a family.

selected.text: Would that thou mightest become, like unto that ascending Tree, a branch thereof, and like Zacharias and John, become one concerning whom it was said "Grant me from Thyself an heir who shall inherit from me and inherit from the House of Jacob, and make him, O my Lord, one with whom Thou art well pleased." May this be confirmed and made manifest.
selected.reason: Hope of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the correspondent become a branch like Zacharias and John, quoting the prayer for an heir well-pleasing to God; draws on scripture for blessing across generations.

selected.text: Thou hadst mentioned the construction of the sacred edifice and the raising of the mighty temple, and hadst expressed thy utmost desire to help carry earth for that lofty structure. God willing, I shall carry some loads of earth on thy behalf, and this indeed is glad tidings that shall illuminate thy face among the concourse of those drawn nigh.
selected.reason: Promise of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to carry loads of earth for the sacred edifice on behalf of one who longed to help build it; a striking act of service performed for another.

selected.text: O peerless Lord! Make this captive with musk-laden locks a recipient of Thine infinite favors, and grant whatever is the desire of his heart and conscience. Fulfill his need, bestow purity upon his heart, make him a prince of fidelity, and make him firm and steadfast in the station of poverty and nothingness. Heal his pain and fulfill his desire.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a captive with musk-laden locks, asking purity of heart, fidelity, steadfastness in poverty and healing of his pain; a vivid personal petition.

selected.text: O Lord! Immerse in the ocean of Thy mercy this handmaiden of Thy threshold, the mother of Rustam and his noble father. Grant them shelter and refuge in the protection of Thy pardon and forgiveness, and favor them with Thy special grace in the proximity of Thy bounties. Thou art the Forgiver, the All-Merciful, the Compassionate, the All-Bountiful.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to immerse the mother and father of Rustam in mercy and shelter them in pardon; complete prayer for a believer’s parents.

selected.text: My Lord, make him a diffuser of the divine fragrances, a remover of veils, a reciter of clear verses, and a healer of every chronic disease. My Lord, make him speak with proof and evidence, inspire him with the essence of explanation and exposition, raise through him the banner of assurance, and unfurl through him the sail of grace and beneficence
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a believer become a diffuser of fragrances, a remover of veils and a healer of every chronic disease; prayer for gifts of speech and healing.

selected.text: O Thou kind and beloved Lord! These friends are exhilarated with the wine of the Covenant and are wanderers in the wilderness of Thy love. Their hearts are consumed by the flames of remoteness from Thee, and they yearn eagerly for the revelation of Thy splendours. From Thine invisible Kingdom, the Realm of the unseen, reveal unto them the effulgent glory of Thy grace, and shed upon them the radiance of Thy bounty. At every moment, send forth a
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O Abdullah! Upon thee be the peace of God, the Lord of all names and Creator of heaven. The mother and sister and other sister and two sons - all are remembered before the Wronged One. We make mention of Hibatu'llah, upon him be God's peace and favor, and We beseech God, exalted be His glory, for each one that which causeth elevation and ascendancy.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh that a believer’s mother, sisters and sons are all remembered before the Wronged One, with prayer for each one’s elevation; a whole household named.

selected.text: O God! O God! Verily, this Thy handmaid is attracted by Thy holy fragrances, and she hath turned her face toward Thy merciful countenance. Ordain for her every good in Thy Kingdom and shower Thy blessings upon this noble family. Let the lights of Thy mercy encompass them unto all eternity and keep them beneath the shield of Thy protection and support.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a handmaid attracted by holy fragrances and for her noble family, that the lights of mercy encompass them for all eternity; a full household prayer.

selected.text: and day, heart and soul are engaged with utmost humility and supplication at the threshold of the Divine Unity in prayer: "O Kind Beloved! Show the light of Thy countenance to the lovers and revive the yearning ones with the life-giving breeze. Give the living waters to the thirsty ones and bestow special gifts upon those attracted to Thee. Especially that family whose men were among the longtime friends and whose women were leaders among the handmaidens of the Merciful
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for lovers and yearning ones and especially for a family whose men were longtime friends and whose women were leaders among the handmaidens; joins general and particular petition.

selected.text: O my God, my Lord and my Hope! Thou knowest that the Wronged One loveth to make mention of the son of him who turned towards Thy horizon, who arose to serve Thee, who spoke forth Thy praise, and who led Thy sheep to Thy spring. I beseech Thee, O God of the world and Desire of the nations, to ordain for him the best of what Thou hast sent down in Thy Book.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh making mention of the son of one who arose to serve, spoke God’s praise and led His sheep to His spring; honors a parent’s service in praying for a child.

selected.text: My Lord confirmeth, maketh things pleasant, bestoweth His blessings, His most great guidance, most mighty grace, the happiness of both this world and the world to come, and changeth sorrows and anguish into gladness and joy. With every breath I beg of Abha Kingdom that He may confirm you, gladden your hearts, bless you and glorify all the friends of Saysan
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that with every breath He begs that the friends of Saysan be confirmed and that sorrows turn to joy; prayer for a named community.

selected.text: My God, my God! This is Thy servant who is related to him whose breast Thou didst expand through the light of Thy knowledge … Make him a sign of Thy oneness, an emblem of Thy glorification, a flower of Thy gardens, a fish in Thy pools, a branch in Thy groves, a lamp of Thy love, a niche for the light of Thy knowledge, and a jewel in the crown of Thy gift
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a relative of a believer, asking that he become a flower, a fish in God’s pools, a branch in His groves and a jewel in His crown; rich family imagery.

selected.text: O Lord! Thou seest how he hath been tried in Thy path. Deprive him not of that which Thou hast ordained for the sincere ones among Thy chosen ones and for them that are nigh unto Thee among Thy loved ones. Aid him in all conditions to remain steadfast in Thy remembrance and praise, and to speak forth among Thy servants, detached from all else besides Thee.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for one tried in God’s path, that he remain steadfast in remembrance and speak forth detached from all else; steadfastness under trial.

selected.text: Thanks be unto Thee that we traversed mountain and desert and crossed the mighty ocean until we reached this region. Throughout this land we mentioned Thy name and fame, even in this church, like unto Elijah, we called unto Thy Kingdom. O Lord! Make the people of this church attracted to Thy beauty, keep them safe and protected in Thy shelter, and bless them.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá written at Unity Church that the people of this church be attracted, protected and blessed; prayer for another religious community.

selected.text: O Lord! These brothers are loving, companions and friends. They seek Your face, tread Your path, speak Your mysteries. Grant them stability, bestow praise, confirm them, reveal the verses of unity, make them honored, make them ecstatic, illumine them, make them lamps of the gathering. You are the Powerful and Mighty. Verily You are the Generous, the Most High.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for loving brothers who seek God’s face, that they be made lamps of the gathering; brothers remembered together.

selected.text: O Lord, O Shelter and Refuge! In that port the loving friends arranged a gathering of fellowship and adorned an assembly with holy fragrances. Day and night they engaged in the recitation of verses and chanted praises and attributes with the most wondrous melodies. With utmost humility and supplication they sought forgiveness for their errors and transgressions.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá describing friends in a port who held a gathering of fellowship, chanted verses and sought forgiveness for their errors; narrative of a praying community.

selected.text: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Prophets, Thy chosen ones, Thy pure ones, and by Muhammad Thy Messenger, and by His family and companions who aided Thy religion and sacrificed their wealth, their souls and their blood in Thy path, to ordain for him that which will profit him in all the worlds of Thy worlds and cause his mention to endure among Thy servants.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh by Muhammad and His family and companions who sacrificed in God’s path, asking lasting benefit for a believer; honors an earlier dispensation.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O God of all beings and Educator of all created things, by the waves of the ocean of Thy bounty and the effulgent lights of the Day-Star of Thy generosity unto Thy servants, to ordain for this servant of Thine that which will exalt Thy name amongst Thy creatures. Then write down for me what Thou hast written for Thy chosen ones and Thy trusted ones.
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: In this moment when 'Abdu'l-Baha is in the utmost state of supplication and imploring, and is prostrate at the Sacred Threshold of the Lord of Mercy, I became occupied with your remembrance and, God willing, at a time filled with spirit and fragrance, I shall recite the Prayer of Visitation on your behalf facing the Blessed Spot, and I shall beseech boundless favors
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that, prostrate at the Threshold, He remembered a correspondent and will recite the Prayer of Visitation on her behalf; women remembered at the Shrine.

selected.text: My God, my God! Verily, Thy servant Baqir, of radiant countenance and illumined heart, implores Thee and hopes for Thy favors and awaits the wonders of Thy tender mercies. O Lord! Assist him against the enemies and strengthen him with mighty power and loosen his tongue in praise and cause him to speak through the confirmation of the Holy Spirit in the Abha Kingdom
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a named servant, asking help against enemies and that he speak through the confirmation of the Holy Spirit; speech under pressure.

selected.text: My Lord, my hope, my shelter and my refuge! Assist this divine youth with the hosts of inspiration and cause him to praise You among the people, and make him Your brilliant sign and Your evident standard among the people until he speaks with the most wondrous utterance in gatherings of knowledge and wisdom and composes marvelous works containing proofs and arguments
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a divine youth speak with wondrous utterance in gatherings of knowledge and compose works containing proofs; prayer for scholarly gifts.

selected.text: O Lord! Illumine his sight with the witnessing of all Thy signs, strengthen his resolve to serve Thee among the God-fearing, grant him a way out in all matters, make easy for him all that is difficult, and strengthen him with the hosts of divine inspiration that he may guide mankind to the fountain of life in the garden of good-pleasure and the paradise of the heart.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that God grant a servant a way out in all matters and make easy all that is difficult, that he may guide mankind; relief tied to service.

selected.text: O my Lord!
